name: LobeChat
description: A polished chat interface for many model providers, in its client-side edition: conversations, settings and the provider keys each person enters stay in their own browser, and the container itself keeps nothing. This is the last LobeChat 1.x release; LobeHub 2 replaced the access code with accounts on PostgreSQL.

access.note: LobeChat has no accounts in this edition; the generated access code is the whole credential. The page opens for anyone, and the first message asks for the code, which you reveal from the Variables tab and paste into the settings once per browser. Without a provider key on the server, each person enters their own under Settings → Language Model; to share one, add it as a variable such as OPENAI_API_KEY.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open. LobeChat builds no absolute URLs in this edition, so nothing else here changes when it is set.

update.notes: Nothing is kept in the container, so an update is a plain image swap. Do not move to lobehub/lobehub 2.x by changing the tag: it refuses ACCESS_CODE and needs a database.

secrets.name: access-code
secrets.label: Access code
secrets.description: Reveal it from the Variables tab; everybody who chats enters it once per browser.
